name: West End House Camp
description_short: A non-profit summer camp for boys in Parsonsfield, Maine. Boys take part in team sports, water activities, STEM experiments, chess tournaments and large group competitions. Sessions run 2, 3, 4 or 7 weeks.

sources.note: Sessions and pricing page: 2027 dates, full and subsidized rates, Apply Online link; footer says non-profit summer camp for boys, with address, phone and email
Camp life: around 120 campers, ages 7-15; overnight cabins

source.title: Half and Full Summer Sessions in Maine | West End House Camp

warnings: Every session has two prices, chosen by the family on the honor system: a Full Tuition Rate and a Subsidized Tuition Rate. Session prices recorded here are the Full rate. Subsidized rates: 7 wk $8,545; 4 wk $5,470; 3 wk $4,365; 2 wk $3,295. price_min uses the lowest subsidized rate.
This is a boys-only camp. A separate girls camp (WEH Girls Camp) is linked but not covered here.
Overnight stays are implied by multi-week summer sessions in Maine, but the page never says 'overnight' outright.
The two 2-week sessions both list July 10 (one ends, the other starts that day).
CIT program price not listed; inquiry required.
unknowns: Meals (assumed included for residential camp but not stated)
Registration open date and session availability
